name: Canceling the Free Coordinates of a Positioned Cube
statement: Suppose a positioned cube fixing the signs of a partial pattern $q$ is contained in a convex-realizable Boolean class $C$, and fix a feasible normalized coefficient array. Then there is a strictly separated witness vector with the prescribed signs on the fixed support of $q$ and zeros on every free cube coordinate.
proof: Choose strict witnesses for all cube vertices. Pair vertices opposite in one free coordinate and take a positive convex combination that cancels that coordinate. Fixed signs and all strict linear separator inequalities survive. Repeat over the free coordinates; previously canceled coordinates remain zero.
